Name: Geuel, Son of Machi
Summary: Geuel, Son of Machi was one of the twelve spies Moses sent from the tribe of Gad to search out the land of Canaan.
KeyStory: Geuel spent forty days spying out Canaan, then joined the ten who brought back a fearful report that turned Israel back into the wilderness.
LifeLesson: Seeing the same land as Caleb, he saw only giants — faith is a choice about what you trust.
